originals.meaning: Retained pre-phase committed bytes. Genuine pre-edit observations are identified separately; other originals are Git evidence only, not fabricated observations.

Preparation retains exact proposal/guards, refreshed or changed selections require explicit adoption, drafts survive task/map return, and shared exact-identity recovery inspects a lost committed response without replay.

Explicit native-annotation read facet reuses historical pin resolution across core/typed HTTP/CLI, including deletion. Default native-input reads retain external-content refusal; neither read observes bytes.

Exact pair comparison retains displayed identities until explicit adoption, separates native/topology/reference/content facts and uncertainty, preserves unchanged context and original failure outcomes.

Adding an optional facet to a previously exact-key query initially rejected old native-pin requests; ordinary strict required/optional query validation restores both forms, with regression checks.
Initial fixture attempted an invalid schema transition and included a receipt without inputs; corrected fixtures respect existing guards.
Pagination fixture initially assumed an opening receipt declared product dependencies; actual discovery correctly returned only the five explicitly declaring receipts.

Initial integrated browser run found selected-reader metadata pushing content below the existing narrow geometry budget and a legacy test still expecting the superseded workspace capture protocol. Metadata ordering and controlled/shared-recovery expectations were corrected; no geometry bound or no-replay assertion weakened.

An intermediate complete functional run passed 714 unit/213 browser/workbench checks, but the unchanged final health gate identified zero runtime coverage of the retained native-only capture closure. A meaningful legacy UI compatibility task was added before the final complete run; coverage thresholds were unchanged.

A later full browser run found a fixture relying on an unsorted record being in the first 50 choices. Search is now explicit; failed-read safety is tested against capture context rather than an independent catalogue. Three independent seeded repetitions passed before the final complete run.
Measured component/hook complexity prompted separate state/read/selection owners and consolidated form/navigation state. No gate, threshold or exclusion changed.
